One-line description: AI assistant for CA firms to reconcile GST data and draft notice replies.
What have you built?: A web app where CA firms upload books and GST portal data. It matches invoices, flags mismatches and drafts notice replies for the CA to review.
Customers: 24 paying CA firms, 7 on free trial. 2 firms have churned.
Revenue: Monthly recurring revenue INR 78,000 (INR 9.4 L annualised).
Customer acquisition: Mostly the founders' network and referrals from other CAs. We have not measured acquisition cost yet.
Accuracy and liability: Every drafted reply is reviewed by the CA before filing. Responsibility sits with the CA.
Key risks: Model errors on unusual notices and dependence on GST portal data formats.
Use of funds: Engineering and AI, sales, compliance and security.
Anything else we should know?: We believe CA firms are underserved by existing tools. We would welcome a call.
Founder background: Dhruv Shah (CEO): Qualified Chartered Accountant, 4 years in practice handling GST for about 60 clients. Isha Merchant (CTO): 3 years at a SaaS company. Built the matching engine.
